2024-07-04_160000.webp.description: Centre of Tekes, the Bagua City. Officially a county-level city, though to me it feels more like a small but rather modern town.

2024-07-04_205300.webp.description: Tekes at night. The city is laid out in the shape of the Taoist Bagua (Eight Trigrams), with roads radiating from the centre, so it needs no traffic lights.

2024-07-04_214500.webp.description: Supper and drinks near a park south of the city centre, where we pitched our tent.

2024-07-05_131400.webp.description: Officially entering Zhaosu County on the highway.

2024-07-05_145740.webp.description: Crows along the highway to Zhaosu.

2024-07-06_135019.webp.description: WJ (left) and AP (right) at the end of the Xiata Trail.

2024-07-06_145324.webp.description: It was my first time seeing a proper snow peak. I didn't feel dwarfed by the mountains, but rather felt a sense of openness, as if we could roam anywhere we wanted.

2024-07-07_115307.webp.description: The last bit of lavender fields near Zhaosu, with snow-capped mountains in the distance.

2024-07-07_173050.webp.description: Along the Yizhao Highway. You can see horses and sheep in the background.

2024-07-07_201502.webp.description: Yizhao Highway's most exposed section, where the road is carved into the cliff.

2024-07-07_215951.webp.description: At this point, we could either sleep hungry in our tent here or cycle to the city in the dark.

2024-07-07_223700.webp.description: Of course we chose to cycle. It was 70km of straight downhill: the best ride ever.

2024-07-10_113646.webp.description: WJ (left) and AP (right) at Sayram Lake.

2024-07-10_170220.webp.description: It's said that Sayram Lake is the furthest point inland that moisture from the Atlantic reaches, hence its nickname, the last teardrop of the Atlantic.

2024-07-10_174928.webp.description: Me holding my bike overhead during my 90km ride around the lake, the last ride of the trip.

2024-07-11_124311.webp.description: Packing our stuff to leave. This was the last stop of our trip, but our story has only just begun.
